renderRecipe.camera: Orthographic, looking at model bounding-box center; radius=max(height,width/(8/9),depth/(8/9))*0.6; position at radius*5 horizontally and center.y+height*0.04. Front=+Z; front quarter=45 degrees; rear quarter=225 degrees.
